local_joint_limit_scope: All neutral q=0. Old8 hip/fold/ankle allow inward negative qdot; knees inward positive. These examples do not prove full path or contact.

why_actual_oil_heat_null: No actual E2 force trajectory, cylinder port pressures, valve/loadholding/regen circuit or losses. Only neutral geometry Q is known. D frozen LP rejected as E2 load input.

facts.pump_rotation: anti-clockwise viewed onto pump shaft, source p7

red_unknowns: Actual E2 mass/COM/body tree/contact LP and dynamic trajectory absent; frozen D LP force/torque witness cannot transfer to new axes.
Uniform + rates at neutral immediately cross hip/fold/ankle upper angle bounds; uniform - rates cross knee lower bound. Inward rate examples respect only local angle direction, not contact/dynamics.
No E2 signed actuator load demand or pair-force/pressure-sharing witness: actual mechanical work, valve pressure drops, oil heat and regeneration are unknown.

Each pair shares one axis qdot and prescribed unequal/same-sign cylinder velocities. Equal pressure/force/flow sharing is not generally valid; valve grouping, cross coupling and synchronization are unselected.
Holding geometric Q=0 is not zero electrical or oil heat: leakage, compensator, unload path, motor standby and positive loadholding hardware unknown.
Below700 rpm is outside cited Z16 running range. Stops, one/two pump staging, unload or storage require a real circuit and verified control; minimum running flow is not mandatory full-pressure burn.
Pump excess at3000 may be unloaded, throttled, stored, or avoided by speed/staging; no route is established. Relief21MPa arithmetic is conditional only.

Negative F*v is externally supplied mechanical energy; it must dissipate, accumulate or return via an explicit recoverable path. Overrunning load can demand counterbalance/backpressure/make-up flow; no regenerative power or braking proof follows from a static capacity bound.
Deenergized valve center, trapped pressure, leaks/rupture, one cylinder or pump failed, synchronization runaway, overpressure, thermal expansion and gravity safe stop are unresolved.
Manufacturer duty100% and LC coolant conditions do not prove installation heat rejection, pump inlet/cavitation, filtered oil/viscosity, shaft coupling, current/voltage or complete robot endurance.
joint_reversal_scope: Reverse cylinder motion by port states; negative joint qdot does not authorize reversing the cited constant gear pump rotation.
single_pump_failure_scope: One3500rpm pump delivers only34.65–37.345 L/min under ownetaV; it cannot cover40.381477L/min uniform positive0.1 demand. Reduced motion or alternate circuit is unverified; no N-1 performance claim.
